newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Trustco sets three, five-year notes.
newsitem.headline: Canada Trustco sets three, five-year notes.

text.p: Canada Trustco Mortgage Company on Tuesday set C$250 million in three-year notes and C$350 million in five-year notes, said lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc.

The C$250 million in three-year notes, which mature on December 3, 1999, had an interest rate of 4.65 percent and were priced to yield 24 basis points over the Government of Canada 9.25 percent bond due December 1, 1999.
The five-year notes due December 3, 2001, had an interest rate of 5.45 percent and were set to yield 28 basis points over Canada's 9.75 percent bond due December 1, 2001.
The settlement date for both issues is November 29, 1996. The notes pay interest on June 3 and December 3 until they mature and are not redeemable prior to maturity.
